newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London lower after profit taking.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London lower after profit taking.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks declined from their record Hong Kong close in thin London trade on Thursday, dealers said.

The Hang Seng London Reference Index fell 71.25 points to 12,933.55 by 1439 GMT after the Hang Seng advanced 61.11 points to close above 13,000 points for the first time ever at 13,004.80 earlier today.
Dealers said profit taking in London caused share prices to drift below their closing levels in Hong Kong and softer U.S. Treasury bond prices after U.S. CPI today depressed them further.
"While U.S. treasuries remain softer, Hong Kong shares will continue to drift," said one trader.
The U.S. CPI rose 0.3 percent in October, broadly in line with analysts forecsts.
Bellweather HSBC Holdings fell HK$1.25 from their Hong Kong close to HK$160.75 by 1439 GMT in London.
